description: This source file implements parsing and error handling for certificate policies in a cryptographic library, including functions to parse policy qualifiers, certificate policies extension, policy constraints, and policy mappings according to RFC 5280.

classes.name: PolicyInformation
classes.description: Represents the policy information structure used in certificate policies extension.

methods.name: ParsePolicyQualifiers
methods.description: Parses policy qualifiers sequence, validating OIDs and qualifiers, optionally restricting to known qualifiers.

methods.name: ParseCertificatePoliciesExtensionImpl
methods.description: Core function to parse the certificate policies extension, extracting policy OIDs and information.

methods.name: ParseCertificatePoliciesExtension
methods.description: Parses the certificate policies extension, returning a list of policies.

methods.name: ParseCertificatePoliciesExtensionOids
methods.description: Parses the extension to extract only policy OIDs.

methods.name: ParsePolicyConstraints
methods.description: Parses the policy constraints extension, extracting explicit policy and inhibit policy mapping values.

methods.name: ParseInhibitAnyPolicy
methods.description: Parses the inhibit any policy extension, extracting the number of remaining certificates.

methods.name: ParsePolicyMappings
methods.description: Parses the policy mappings extension, extracting issuer and subject domain policies.
